title: Push-based KV transfer to improve TTFT and TPOT for disaggregated inference in vLLM
summary: vLLM's prefill-decode disaggregation splits LLM inference across engine instances but must transfer the KV cache between them. This post introduces a push-based NIXL connector that moves transfer coordination off the critical path, delivering up to 3x better TTFT and 30% better T
